=== EMAIL to guest@example.com
Subject: One step remains before p.stonn can manage your visitor permit
Provenance: You received this at guest@example.com because you signed up for p.stonn with this address but have not yet linked a council account. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

You signed up for p.stonn, but you have not linked your council account yet, so p.stonn cannot do anything for you. The roster, bookings, guest passes and visitor QR all depend on that link.

Linking takes one sign-in with your City of Stonnington ePermits details. Most people who get stuck have run into one of three things.

1. If you have forgotten your ePermits password, or have never set one, the council can reset it for you.
Reset it at the council:
https://parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au/idm/account/ForgotPassword

2. p.stonn can only link to the ePermits account registered under the address you signed up with (guest@example.com). If your council account uses a different email, sign in to p.stonn with that address instead.

3. If you signed up from a Facebook link, you were using Facebook’s built-in browser, which does not fill in saved passwords.
Open p.stonn in Safari or Chrome:
https://p.stonn.org

p.stonn can only manage a visitor permit you already hold, and it never changes a resident permit or applies for a new one.

If you do not have an ePermits account or a visitor permit yet, please apply for a visitor permit on the council’s ePermits site first, then come back.
Register with the council:
https://parkingpermits.stonnington.vic.gov.au/idm/account/Register

This is the only reminder p.stonn sends. If you’ve decided it’s not for you, there’s nothing to undo. Your details go no further than the sign-up you made.
